home.heroTitle: Managing & Developing IT Systems for Public Transport
home.heroDesc: The Department of Information Technology Systems (DITS) leads the development, operation, and security of digital platforms, IT infrastructure, and e-services for the Ministry of Public Works and Transport.
home.techTeaserDesc: We build and operate state-of-the-art information platforms serving citizens and government officials across Cambodia.
